mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ride_orders (user_id, vehicle_id, start_station_id, start_time, status, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{vehicleId}, #{startStationId}, #{startTime}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.id as u_id, u.username as u_username, u.phone as u_phone, u.role as u_role, u.status as u_status, v.id as v_id, v.vehicle_code as v_vehicle_code, v.vehicle_type as v_vehicle_type, v.status as v_status, v.battery_level as v_battery_level, ss.id as ss_id, ss.station_name as ss_station_name, ss.address as ss_address, es.id as es_id, es.station_name as es_station_name, es.address as es_address FROM ride_orders r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN vehicles v ON r.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN stations ss ON r.start_station_id = ss.id LEFT JOIN stations es ON r.end_station_id = es.id ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
